hiveSql:
SELECT
									object_id,
									s_info_windcode,
									financial_trade_dt,
									trade_crncy_code,
									tot_shr_today,
									float_a_shr_today,
									s_val_mv,
									s_dq_mv,
									s_dq_close_today,
									s_pq_high_52w,
									s_pq_low_52w,
									s_val_pb_new,
									s_val_pe_lyr,
									s_val_pe_ttm,
									s_val_pcf_ocflyr,
									s_val_pcf_ocfttm,
									s_val_pcf_ncflyr,
									s_val_pcf_ncfttm,
									s_val_ps_lyr,
									s_val_ps_ttm,
									s_dq_turn,
									crncy_code,
									net_assets_today,
									net_profit_parent_comp_lyr,
									net_profit_parent_comp_ttm,
									net_cash_flows_oper_act_lyr,
									net_cash_flows_oper_act_ttm,
									oper_rev_lyr,
									oper_rev_ttm,
									net_incr_cash_cash_equ_lyr,
									net_incr_cash_cash_equ_ttm,
									opdate,
									opmode,
									busi_month
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_hkshareeodderivativeindex where busi_month between cast(substr(cast(${beg_date} as string),1,6) as decimal(8,0)) 
							and cast(substr(cast(${end_date} as string),1,6) as decimal(8,0))
